title: Count Number of Trapezoids I
summary: Given a 2D integer array points, where each element points[i] = [xi, yi] represents the coordinates of the i-th point on the Cartesian plane, count the number of unique horizontal trapezoids that can be formed by choosing any four distinct points.
statement: Given a 2D integer array points, where each element points[i] = [xi, yi] represents the coordinates of the i-th point on the Cartesian plane, count the number of unique horizontal trapezoids that can be formed by choosing any four distinct points. A horizontal trapezoid is defined as a convex quadrilateral with at least one pair of horizontal sides (i.e., parallel to the x-axis). Two lines are considered parallel if and only if they have the same slope. Since the result can be a large number, return it modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Choose two horizontal point-pairs on different y-levels.
reference_solution:
def count_horizontal_trapezoids(points):
    from collections import Counter
    mod=10**9+7;total_pairs=0;answer=0
    for count in Counter(y for x,y in points).values():
        pairs=count*(count-1)//2
        answer=(answer+total_pairs*pairs)%mod;total_pairs+=pairs
    return answer
